title: If/Else block asymmetry
description: Code-style rule — scripts containing If/Else blocks where the If branch is significantly longer than the Else branch. Candidates for refactoring into early returns or guard clauses. Thresholds adjustable via the header sliders (default If ≥ 10, Else ≤ 2 steps).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A long If branch paired with a short (or empty) Else usually inverts the natural reading order — the exceptional case is handled first and the main path is buried, which hurts readability and testability.
rule.remediation: Invert the condition and handle the short case first as a guard clause / early return, so the main path stays at the top nesting level.
